title: Real data: leaf photosynthetic traits
text: settings paper: 5,000 burn-5,000 kept iterations, 100 regression trees 50 missingness trees. fit took 1.4 minutes (eight fits running time).
code: library(missBART)  data <- as.data.frame(readxl::read_excel("Maire_dataset_for_Andrew.xlsx", sheet = "Data")) y <- as.matrix(log(data[, c("SLA", "Aarea", "Narea", "Parea", "Gs")])) x <- as.matrix(data[, which(names(data) == "PPTmean"):ncol(data)])  set.seed(1) fit1 <- missBART1(x, y, n_trees = 100, burn = 5000, iters = 5000, thin = 1) fit2 <- missBART2(x, y, n_reg_trees = 100, n_class_trees = 50, burn = 5000, iters = 5000, thin = 1)

title: Quick start
text: simulate two correlated responses five covariates, delete values probability increases value . observed values biased sample: missing values larger average observed ones.
code: set.seed(2024) n <- 400 x <- matrix(runif(n * 5), ncol = 5) f <- cbind(10 * sin(pi * x[, 1] * x[, 2]) + 20 * (x[, 3] - 0.5)^2 + 10 * x[, 4] + 5 * x[, 5],            5 * x[, 1] - 8 * x[, 2]^2 + 3 * x[, 3]) y_true <- f + matrix(rnorm(2 * n), ncol = 2) %*% chol(matrix(c(1, 0.6, 0.6, 1), 2))  y <- y_true y[runif(n) < pnorm(-1 + 1.2 * scale(y_true[, 1])), 1] <- NA y[runif(n) < pnorm(-1 + 1.2 * scale(y_true[, 2])), 2] <- NA colMeans(is.na(y)) #> [1] 0.2375 0.2625 rbind(observed = colMeans(y, na.rm = TRUE),       missing = c(mean(y_true[is.na(y[, 1]), 1]), mean(y_true[is.na(y[, 2]), 2]))) #>              [,1]      [,2] #> observed 12.77439 0.2265791 #> missing  19.15552 4.3086642

title: Quick start
text: Fitting multivariate BART complete cases predicting incomplete rows ignores reason values missing.
code: cc <- complete.cases(y) fit0 <- mvBART(x[cc, ], y[cc, ], x_predict = x[!cc, ], n_trees = 50, burn = 500,                iters = 500, thin = 1, show_progress = FALSE) pred0 <- matrix(NA, n, 2) pred0[!cc, ] <- predict(fit0)  rmse <- function(a, b) sqrt(mean((a - b)^2)) c(complete_cases = rmse(pred0[fit1$missing_index], truth),   missBART1 = rmse(imp1$mean, truth),   missBART2 = rmse(imputed_values(fit2)$mean, truth)) #> complete_cases      missBART1      missBART2  #>       1.491053       1.124269       1.188220

code: library(missBART)  set.seed(1) n <- 500 x <- matrix(runif(n * 5), ncol = 5) y_true <- cbind(10 * sin(pi * x[, 1] * x[, 2]) + 10 * x[, 4], 5 * x[, 1] - 8 * x[, 2]^2) +   matrix(rnorm(2 * n), ncol = 2)  # large values are more likely to be missing y <- y_true y[runif(n) < pnorm(-1 + scale(y_true[, 1])), 1] <- NA y[runif(n) < pnorm(-1 + scale(y_true[, 2])), 2] <- NA  fit1 <- missBART1(x, y)                      # probit regression missingness model fit2 <- missBART2(x, y, n_class_trees = 20)  # probit BART missingness model  fit1 head(imputed_values(fit1))   # posterior summaries of the missing responses y_complete <- completed_data(fit1) coef(fit1)                   # probit coefficients: is the missingness driven by y? varimp(fit2)                 # which predictors the missingness trees split on

text: x numeric matrix (data frame) covariates. Missing covariate values allowed missBART2() mvBART(), handled inside trees; missBART1() needs complete covariates. y numeric matrix (vector) responses, NA missing values. x_predict optional covariates make --sample predictions. n_trees, n_reg_trees number trees BART model responses. burn number burn-iterations. iters number posterior samples kept burn-thinning. thin thinning interval. sampler runs burn + thin * iters iterations. predict logical. Make predictions x_predict? tree_prior_params tree prior proposal settings, see tree_list(). hypers hyperparameters BART model responses, see hypers_list(). scale logical. Scale response [-0.5, 0.5] fitting? missBART1() also scales covariates, B_post refers scaled variables. Everything else returned original scale. include_x, include_y logical. Use x /y predictors missingness? include_y = FALSE assumes responses missing random. show_progress logical. Print iteration count? progress_every often update iteration count. pdp_range, make_pdp missBART2() univariate response: make_pdp = TRUE, latent missingness predictor evaluated grid (scaled) response values spanning pdp_range every kept iteration returned pdp_out; apply stats::pnorm() get probability observed. Ignored missBART1(), curves follow directly B_post. mice_impute logical. Initialise missing responses mice::mice()? Otherwise start centre observed range. ymis_update Gaussian update missing responses treats rows partly missing. "conditional" (default) conditions observed responses row. "marginal" draws corresponding margin full-row distribution, written Appendix C.1 paper done versions 0.2.0. two agree univariate responses. Used missBART1(), missBART2() include_y = FALSE. probit_prior gamma prior settings precisions probit coefficients missBART1(), see probit_prior_list(). save_y_pred logical. Keep posterior predictive draws training data (y_pred)? save_z logical. Keep draws latent probit variables (z_post)? ... arguments passed tree_list() hypers_list(). Arguments earlier versions longer used ignored. n_class_trees number trees probit BART model missingness indicators. MH_sd standard deviation random-walk proposal missing responses missBART2(). Defaults 0.5 / ncol(y).

title: missBART 0.2.0
text: samplers behind missBART1() (formerly missBARTprobit()), missBART2() mvBART() now written C++ roughly 80 350 times faster version 0.1.0; see README timings. Results reproducible set.seed(), draws differ version 0.1.0 seed.

title: missBART 0.2.0
text: change results relative version 0.1.0. Missing responses partly observed rows. Gaussian update missing responses (missBART1(), missBART2() include_y = FALSE) now conditions observed responses row. Version 0.1.0, Appendix C.1 paper written, draw margin full-row distribution instead, ignores residual correlation observed missing responses row. ymis_update = "marginal" restores old behaviour. two agree univariate responses. Node marginal likelihood. one response, version 0.1.0 computed quadratic form node marginal likelihood sum(Sigma_inv %*% mu^2) rather t(mu) %*% Sigma_inv %*% mu. formula paper now used. Inverse-Wishart degrees freedom parameter-expanded update probit correlation matrix n + p + 1 (Talhouk et al., 2012, usual parameterisation) instead n - p + 3. Prior precisions probit coefficients. One precision drawn covariates one responses, Appendix B paper. Version 0.1.0 drew separate value every coefficient pooled full conditional. Latent probit variables missBART1() one response updated one coordinate time univariate truncated normal full conditionals, instead exact draw multivariate truncated normal TruncatedNormal::rtmvnorm() every row. Tree proposals. Split values always drawn within range covariate still available node. Version 0.1.0 used interval (0, 1) change move root, restricted trees whose deepest node depth 3 grow prune moves. Trees can send missing covariate values left right every split, missingness indicators added covariates missing values. mvBART() now respects hypers$kappa.

title: missBART 0.2.0
text: New name missBART1(), matching paper; missBARTprobit() still works. Fits class "missBART" print(), summary(), fitted(), predict() coef() methods, helpers imputed_values(), completed_data() varimp(). New arguments ymis_update, probit_prior (see probit_prior_list()), save_y_pred save_z. omega_post (also available sigma_post) always holds full residual covariance matrices original scale. used hold variances scale = TRUE one response. new_y_hat new holds BART mean function x_predict; new_y_post holds posterior predictive draws, . var_imp matrix split counts (iterations predictors) rather list tables; var_imp_reg regression trees. y_miss_accept holds one acceptance rate per missing value rather iterations--values matrix. tau_b longer leading row NA. pdp_out (missBART2(), univariate response) one element per kept iteration, longer accumulates across iterations. missBART1() longer returns pdp_out; compute curves B_post. trees terminal node parameters (reg_trees, class_trees, reg_mu, class_mu, accepted_trees) longer returned. arguments true_trees_data, true_trees_missing, true_change_points true_change_points_miss ignored. Dependencies CholWishart, extraDistr, TruncatedNormal, Matrix, MASS ggplot2 dropped; Rcpp RcppArmadillo added. package pkgdown website (built docs/) quick start vignette articles, including re-run simulation studies paper. unexported plotting helpers plot_posterior() plot_plant_posterior() removed.
